caption: One brewing stand: a clock (two hoppers passing 106 stones back and forth, a copper bulb remembering the direction) splits time into two halves of 42 seconds. When the brewing half starts, the bottles hopper beside the stand is unlocked, one dropper puts a nether wart into the hopper on top of the stand and a second dropper, a moment later, a sugar, which waits there until the wart is used up: the stand brews awkward potions, then swiftness. In the other half the hopper under the stand takes the three potions to the output chest while the bottles hopper is locked (a repeater keeps it locked a moment longer when the halves change, so a fresh bottle is never taken out unbrewed). Blaze powder goes into the stand's side from the fuel chest.
